inspiral.application_timer_scope: HDF run_time * (1 - setup_time_fraction); excludes setup/output and has no additional device fence; not qualified warm compute.

profile.outer_scope: Includes capture/report processing; excluded from timing samples.

live.suffix_scope: Observed suffix after two valid blocks; tracing/lowering/cache activity continues; not qualified steady-state.

full_process_scope: Fresh observer process launch through completion/output/shutdown; includes observer imports and in-process source checks, excludes separate prime and profile. Native-command runner scope is different.
gpu_activity_definition: Exact union of captured selected-application GPU kernel/memcpy intervals; memsets and unrelated processes excluded. Not SM occupancy, saturation or whole-device utilization.
numeric_precision_note: Sample values preserve receipt precision; prime and outer profiler values shown here are rounded diagnostic context. Exact profile interval summaries are under profiles/.
